delivery_target: finalise_cap_replaceable and other consumers of suspend_unlive' that currently require valid_objs in their preconditions
new_lemma:
lemma suspend_unlive'_no_valid_objs:
  "\\<lbrace>bound_tcb_at ((=) None) t and valid_mdb and tcb_at t\\<rbrace>
      suspend t
   \\<lbrace>\\<lambda>rv. obj_at (Not \\<circ> live) t\\<rbrace>"
  apply (simp add: suspend_def set_thread_state_def set_object_def get_object_def)
  supply hoare_vcg_if_split[wp_split del] if_split[split del]
  apply (wp | simp only: obj_at_exst_update)+
     apply (simp add: obj_at_def live_def hyp_live_def)
     apply (rule_tac Q="\<lambda>_. bound_tcb_at ((=) None) t" in hoare_strengthen_post)
      supply hoare_vcg_if_split[wp_split]
      apply wp
     apply (auto simp: pred_tcb_def2)[1]
    apply (simp flip: if_split)
    apply wp
   apply wp
  apply simp
  done
rationale: The proof body of suspend_unlive' never mentions valid_objs. The wp chain uses hoare_strengthen_post with bound_tcb_at as the intermediate post; that derivation depends only on bound_tcb_at in the precondition. Dropping valid_objs is a plausible strengthening for trial.
strengthening_claim: (bound_tcb_at ((=) None) t and valid_mdb and tcb_at t) ==> (bound_tcb_at ((=) None) t and valid_mdb and valid_objs and tcb_at t)
